scope: BROWSER synthetic Accounts, two managed Chromium Workers and separate Python Node; no ordinary UI, active service worker or deployed acceptance

gates.name: sender pending across one-sided confirmed successor
checks: sender local PENDING returned within five seconds without waiting for Node
lost initial FINAL and first authenticated application ACK recovered
one-sided active state loss recovered as confirmed generation two
same logical operation stored once at recipient
successor used fresh root-bound ciphertext and outer transport operation
authenticated ACK marked existing sender history DELIVERED and retired outbox

gates.name: recipient Worker offline at first application send
checks: sender local PENDING returned within five seconds while recipient offline
first encrypted send attempted while recipient Worker absent
recipient returned with same Node identity
exact inner Account ciphertext retried, recipient history stored once
authenticated ACK alone marked existing sender history DELIVERED and retired outbox

limits: browser fixtures use synthetic Accounts and direct runtime calls rather than ordinary UI actions
typed CONTROL and media semantics are not part of these gates
full N4 loss matrix, active service worker and deployed acceptance remain open
